fields.meta_description: Build a car rental form that checks each driver's license and logs mileage and damage photos at pickup and return, in a table you own.
fields.h1: Build a Car Rental Form That Checks Every Driver
fields.hero_description: Describe your cars, rates and renter rules. Emergent builds the car rental form, checks each license against the return date and keeps every booking in one table.
fields.features_heading: What Each Booking Records Before Handover
fields.features_subheading: A paper form leaves every check to the counter. This one checks the driver at booking and keeps the evidence after the car is back.
fields.feature_1:
Driver's license details on every booking

Ask for the license number, issuing state, expiry date and date of birth. The form works out the driver's age and refuses any license that runs out before the car is due back.
fields.feature_2:
Insurance proof checked at booking

Collect a photo of the renter's insurance card or declarations page. Emergent copies the policy number and end date onto the booking and flags any field it is unsure of.
fields.feature_3:
Odometer and fuel at both ends

Record the odometer and fuel level when the car leaves and again when it returns. The form subtracts one reading from the other and charges miles past the allowance at your rate.
fields.feature_4:
Damage photos at handover and return

Photograph each side of the car as it leaves and as it comes back. Both sets stay on the booking, ready to show a renter where the new dent is and that it was not there before.
fields.feature_5:
Deposits through your own Stripe account

Take a deposit when the renter books, through the Stripe account you connect. Extra miles or marked damage come out of it at return, and the renter sees the math on the receipt.
fields.feature_6:
An app you can move to your own site

Export the whole codebase to GitHub on paid plans when you want the booking form on your own website, or when a developer needs to connect it to the fleet software you already run.
fields.why_title: Why Build Your Rental Desk on Emergent?
fields.why_description: A paper rental form records what the renter writes. It cannot see a license about to run out or a van back 130 miles over.

fields.usecase_heading: Rental Forms for Four Kinds of Fleet
fields.tab_content_1:
Any renter with an expiring license is stopped

Mesa Auto Rentals checks the license before it holds a car. Renters enter the license number and expiry date, and a license that expires before the return date blocks the booking until it is renewed. Drivers under 25 pay $25 a day on top of the rate. For them, a 4-day compact at $54 a day comes to $316.
fields.tab_content_2:
The guest's insurance card, read on upload

Juniper Car Share lists its own cars on a car-sharing marketplace. Each guest uploads a photo of their insurance card at booking. Emergent reads the policy number and expiry date into the trip record. A field it cannot read cleanly, such as a blurred expiry date, goes to the host to confirm before the trip starts.
fields.tab_content_3:
130 extra miles come out of the deposit

Every Brightline Van Rental van leaves with its odometer reading on the booking. Each rental includes 100 miles a day, and miles past that cost $0.35 each. A 3-day move that comes back 130 miles over owes $45.50, taken from the $300 deposit. The renter gets $254.50 back with both readings on the receipt.
fields.tab_content_4:
When a loaner comes back with a new scuff

Harbor Motors lends cars to customers whose own car is in for service. At handover an advisor takes six walk-around photos for the agreement. At return the same six angles are shot again. Marking a scuff on the rear bumper sends Dana Ruiz, the service manager, a Slack message with both photos of that corner.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Car Rental Form
fields.howto_description: Settle your fleet list and your renter rules before you describe the form.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 List each car the way you rent it
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Decide what a renter has to prove
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Set the deposit and what it covers
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write down every car with its plate, class and daily rate, and note the mileage allowance that comes with it. The form offers renters only the cars on that list, and each booking carries the plate into its record.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Decide the minimum age, whether drivers under 25 pay a fee and which insurance proof you accept, such as a card photo or a declarations page. Each rule becomes a check the booking has to pass before a car is held.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Pick a deposit for each car class and what can come out of it, such as extra miles or damage marked at return. Have a lawyer in your state review those terms before the first renter books a car through the form.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Put your car list and your rental rules into one prompt in plain English. Emergent builds the booking form and the table that holds every rental. When you add a car or change a rate later, ask for it in the same chat.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Connect Stripe to take the deposit at booking and refund the balance after check-in. Your calendar, or any fleet tool with an API, can receive each booking and block those dates for that car. Nobody has to copy a booking across by hand.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Build the pickup and return checklist
fields.howto_step_6_des: Add the odometer and fuel readings and the walk-around photos your staff take at handover. The return checklist asks for the same readings again, and the form compares the two odometer numbers to price any miles over the allowance.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Book a real car through the form on your phone with your own license. Upload a test insurance card, take the photos, then check the car back in with a higher odometer reading and confirm the deposit math on the receipt.

plan.angle: The top 10 is scattered: two Scribd contract uploads, a Guam airport concession RFP, a UN tender, a Grenada hotel inquiry form, an Alamo location page and a Facebook thread on deposits, with template galleries (TemplateLab, Jotform, 123FormBuilder) in the image pack. None shows the checks a small fleet runs before handing over keys. This page names the fields a car rental form needs and then shows what a PDF cannot do: block a license that expires mid-rental, read the renter's insurance card, charge mileage over the daily allowance from the odometer readings, and compare walk-around photos at handover and return.

Under UCC 2A-201, a lease contract with total payments of $1,000 or more is enforceable only with a writing signed by the party it is enforced against that describes the goods leased and the lease term; the section does not mention notarization
The UCC defines writing to include printing, typewriting, or any other intentional reduction to tangible form
Template sites publish free car rental agreements as PDF and Word files
